persona_or_hmw: P4 Rosa; P6 Yuki; course evidence outcome
must_pass: one canonical immutable run manifest records run_id, scenario_hash, configuration hash, versions, seeds, status, timings, and artifact references
state, message, decision, fault, trip, and KPI schemas carry run_id and scenario_hash
decision, fault, and transition rows have unique event_id values within a run
message and disposition rows have immutable message_id values and same-run references
DuckDB joins every Parquet row to exactly one valid manifest and rejects orphan or cross-scenario identifiers
incomplete or corrupt artifacts invalidate the run instead of entering evaluation
gate_checks: all required artifacts exist and parse
join-audit reports zero missing, duplicate, or cross-scenario run_id/event_id/message_id references
manifest status and artifact hashes are immutable after finalization
gate.openDeltas is 0 and gate.decidedBy is tests-and-files
